prompt:
You are expanding this standalone seed runtime into seed agent. Do not change seed.sh or its loop. Do not add API tools. Use only shell and edit. Do not write a TUI or any wrapper around seed. The human interface stays seed (or /bin/sh seed.sh).

Every file you GET from the plugin root is a prompt (JSON prompt field). Agent plugin files are prompts only. There are no shipped scripts or launchers to copy. Invent each block on this machine. Do not wait for an implementation that is not a prompt.

Parked human task: the human's current message. Finish the blocks below first, then do that task.

Plugin root: ${SEED_PLUGIN_ROOT:-https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Leehow/slab/main/plugins}. Fetch with curl into agent-store/plugins/<file>. Files: skills.json, commands.json, models.json, plugins.json, delegate.json. Always GET the file again before building a block so you follow the latest prompt, not a stale cache.

Progress: jq ours.seed_agent on the Machine index (object; missing keys mean not done). Order: skills, then commands, then models, then plugins, then delegate. For each name: GET /agent/<name>.json, follow that prompt, run every check named in that prompt, and only then jq-write ours.seed_agent[name]=done. If the check fails, leave that key unset, tell the human, and stop. Do not mark done because a file exists. If ours.seed_agent.tui is set, delete that key; do not rebuild a TUI.

If a key is already done, still run that block's current checks. If they fail, delete the key, rebuild that block, and do not keep the old file. If the human says 重做 or rebuild plus a block name, do the same for that block.

Put new files under the install directory agent-store/seed-agent/ unless a block says otherwise. Do not dump project source into the memory tree. Do not print API keys. If a GET fails, tell the human and stop; leave later blocks unset.

Rounds are limited per human turn. If the loop prints round limit reached, progress in ours.seed_agent survives: tell the human to reopen with AGENT_MAX_ROUNDS=60 seed and say continue.
